Subject Matter

Access to dataset for factual error review 

 Original question

When an ESG rating provider notifies an issuer or rated item for the purposes of a fact-checking review, is access to the respective dataset granted only upon request?

ESMA Answer

10-07-2026

 Original language

ESG rating providers are required to grant access to the dataset upon request of the issuer or rated item, in which case it should be granted as soon as possible. Alternatively, access to the dataset can be provided automatically, in parallel with the notification. 

Status: Answer Published

 Additional Information

Level 1 Regulation

ESGR - Regulation (EU) 2024/3005

Topic

48-hour rule
